==About me==

I have been reading WOT, for eleven years now. I didn't buy the big white book when it first came out because of the price, but I wanted to very much. I kept thinking about it though, once per year. Then one day, ten years later, a man came up to me and said "I found these in a box near the garbage. Perfectly good books! Imagine that!" and there it was...The BWB.

''My favorite characters are Moiraine and Egwene. Hearning that Moiraine will be brought back is happy news, but I never believed her gone in the first place.''

''The Blue Ajah is my favorite, but perhaps in the end I would choose Green. The idea of having multiple warders appeals to me greatly.''
